entries.name: Active Scientific Knowledge (ASK)
entries.exact_title: Active Scientific Knowledge: A Conceptual Model for Machine-Actionable and Versioned Science
entries.licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 per Crossref; no licence statement inside the PDF
entries.read_route: PDF on this machine; the repo path is a 131-byte git-LFS POINTER and the real 341,902 bytes are in .git/lfs/objects/. Extracted with pdftotext -layout: 11 pages, all sections, Table 1, 23 references. SSRN itself is Cloudflare-blocked even via r.jina.ai.
entries.what_it_is: A conceptual model and roadmap. Its own words: 'a general model, not a universal ontology'.
entries.conformance_evidence: Zero occurrences across all 11 pages of: conformance, conform, compliant, specification, acceptance. Six yes/no questions plus one scoring sentence. Modality is 58 'can', 26 'may', 18 'should', 17 'must', and the 'must' sentences are rhetorical.
entries.implementation_evidence: Zero occurrences of github, gitlab, zenodo, 'source code', 'available at', prototype, 'reference implementation'. The only URL in the body is the author's ORCID; the other 27 are reference DOIs. Worked examples are conditional ('could import', 'could receive an alert').

The paper states its addressable type list ONCE, as a closed enumeration of seven: 'Every claim, dataset, method, instrument, population, outcome, and validation event requires a stable identity and explicit type.' No plan, no experiment, no hypothesis, no action proposal.
dimension_coverage.collective_rl_governance: ABSENT, and not close. Zero occurrences of: reinforcement, reward, feedback, policy, bandit, 'active learning', optimiz*, prioriti*, allocat*, incentive. 'Governance' in this paper means INSTITUTIONAL governance - peer review, credit, funding, federated authority. The ceiling of what ASK offers in this direction is notification, not adaptation: 'A living review could receive an alert when a new result changes the evidence state.'

entries.what_we_may_say: ASK is an unreviewed single-author preprint with no implementation and no conformance definition. We may say our design is INFORMED BY it and cite it. We may NOT say we implement it, conform to it, or that its six dimensions are acceptance criteria - that reading is entirely our construction, and SPEC-087 already says so.
entries.verification_of_our_quotes: 18 quotes used by our two research docs were string-matched against the extracted PDF: all 18 verbatim, with two invented negative controls correctly failing.
entries.count_discrepancies_unresolved: The reporting agent counted 10 files with 'context-preserving' and 7 with 'conditional execution'; my git grep from the repo root over tracked files returns 6 and 4. Different scopes, not reconciled. The substantive claims were confirmed; these counts were not.

seventh_dimension_evidence.where_the_words_sit: experiment* occurs 21 times and hypothes* 7 times, and EVERY occurrence is in the abstract, the Introduction, or 'Why the Transition Has Begun', describing OTHER systems (Adam, Coscientist, Co-Scientist, Robin, The AI Scientist, self-driving labs). NOT ONE appears in 'The ASK Model', 'Entity and Infrastructure Requirements', or 'The ASK Activation Test'. Hypothesis generation is the paper's EVIDENCE that the transition is underway, never part of its object model.
seventh_dimension_evidence.TRAP_expect_this_quoted_at_us: 'Publication under ASK can be understood as a proposal to change a shared knowledge state' - the paper's ONLY use of 'proposal'. It means a publication as a DIFF to the knowledge graph ('introduce a claim, add evidence, narrow a scope'). A change proposal, NOT an action proposal. It does not say what it looks like it says.
seventh_dimension_evidence.strongest_genuine_near_miss: 'protocol versions' in the clinical-trial example: addressable and versioned, but inside a worked example written entirely in the conditional, and a protocol is a method document, not a proposal carrying a falsifier.

entries.consequence_for_our_claims: Our Problem -> Action -> Evidence -> independent review chain is NOT an ASK conformance item and we must stop short of implying it. ASK's unit is a claim with its warrant; ours adds a typed record for the thing you are ABOUT TO DO, which ASK does not model. This is a CANDIDATE DIFFERENTIATOR - but it must be stated as 'ASK does not model this', never as 'we invented it', and it is NOT established until the same dimension is checked against Buehler/LAMM, where it is still open.
entries.hackathon_files_checked: morphoeval-living-records-deep-dive-2026-10-17.md and hackathon-and-partners.md do NOT mention ASK at all: 'active scientific knowledge' 0 hits in each, and a regex for ASK/Firat/7416579/activation-test returned nothing. Positive controls in the same command: 'the' matched 78 and 97 lines, 'morpho' 37 and 2. Both files predate the owner introducing the paper.

the_one_defensible_differentiator.sentence: They have the objects; we add the decision rule to the object, before the result exists.
the_one_defensible_differentiator.why_it_holds: Their gates are real but live in code and in the ACCEPTED artifact's payload - the HEA gate_rule is recorded INSIDE the winning model, so the criterion is written AFTER the verdict, by the winner. Ours is committed to git before the result exists, with the timestamp as the evidence.
the_one_defensible_differentiator.what_is_NOT_defensible: The broader claim that typed research objects or independent review are ours.
the_one_defensible_differentiator.near_miss_to_know: ScienceClaw's mutation_policy LOOKS like a learned policy - versioned, lineage-chained, drift-plotted. It is not. The update only ever lowers the threshold, bumps stagnation on a 15% coin flip, and reads no outcome. A congestion throttle with a version number.
